description: ONLY for an absolute brick wall - something no seat can do with its own reach. Requires reason to be one of the recognised walls, and tried_instead to say what you already attempted: your shell, remote access to the fleet, the vault, the forge, the tool catalog, the other seats. Most walls are not walls. This is the one column that costs the operator time, so a lazy entry is worse than no entry. Clear it with clear_human_action the moment it is resolved.

ask.description: The one thing to do, in plain words.

reason.description: One of the recognised walls. list_lanes with include_induction returns the list.

tried_instead.description: What you already attempted with your own reach. Short answers are rejected.

why.description: Why it cannot be done without a person.

name: raise_human_action
title: Flag an Operations lane as needing the operator
